title.zh-CN: 声明式 UI 与 Composable

summary.zh-CN: Compose 用普通函数描述界面：界面是状态的函数，状态变化时框架重组受影响的组合函数。
summary.en: Compose describes UI with plain functions: the screen is a function of state, and the framework recomposes only affected composables when state changes.

zh-CN: 写出第一个 @Composable 函数并解释它的输入输出
说明声明式 UI 与命令式 View 操作的区别
en: Write a first @Composable function and explain its input and output
Contrast declarative UI with imperative View updates

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个 Greeting(name) 组合函数，并在预览或调用处传入不同参数观察输出变化。
prompt.en: Write a Greeting(name) composable and pass different arguments at the call site to observe how the output changes.

hint.zh-CN: 组合函数返回 Unit，用参数描述界面；不要在里面直接改外部状态。
hint.en: A composable returns Unit and renders from its parameters; avoid mutating external state inside it.

summary.zh-CN: mutableStateOf 保存可观察状态，remember 让状态在重组之间保留；不 remember 的局部变量每次重组都会重置。
summary.en: mutableStateOf holds observable state and remember keeps it across recompositions; a local variable without remember resets on every recomposition.

zh-CN: 用 remember { mutableStateOf(...) } 保存界面状态
解释为什么普通局部变量会导致界面不更新
en: Hold UI state with remember { mutableStateOf(...) }
Explain why a plain local variable fails to update the screen

prompt.zh-CN: 把计数器示例中的普通变量改成 remember 状态，并指出两处必须使用 by 或 .value 的位置。
prompt.en: Change the plain variable in a counter sample into remembered state and point out the two places that must use by or .value.

hint.zh-CN: val count = remember { mutableStateOf(0) } 读取用 count.value，写入用 count.value = ...。
hint.en: val count = remember { mutableStateOf(0) }; read count.value and write count.value = ... .

summary.zh-CN: 把状态从子组件提升到共同父级，子组件只接收值与事件回调，更容易复用和测试。
summary.en: Hoist state to the common parent so children receive only values and event callbacks, which makes them easier to reuse and test.

zh-CN: 把可复用组件的状态提升到调用方
在组件间区分状态值与事件回调的边界
en: Hoist state out of a reusable component to its caller
Separate state values from event callback boundaries

prompt.zh-CN: 把一个自带状态的计算器组件改成状态提升版本：父级持有数值，子组件只接收 value 与 onAdd 回调。
prompt.en: Refactor a stateful calculator component into a state-hoisted version where the parent owns the value and the child receives only value and onAdd.

hint.zh-CN: 签名形如 Counter(value: Int, onIncrement: () -> Unit)；子组件内不 remember 该值。
hint.en: Use a signature such as Counter(value: Int, onIncrement: () -> Unit); the child must not remember that value.

summary.zh-CN: LazyColumn 只组合可见项，适合长列表；必须提供稳定 key，避免重排时丢失状态。
summary.en: LazyColumn composes only visible items and suits long lists; provide stable keys to keep state from being lost when items move.

zh-CN: 用 LazyColumn 展示带 key 的列表
解释为什么长列表不能用 Column 全量渲染
en: Render a keyed list with LazyColumn
Explain why a long list must not use a fully rendered Column

prompt.zh-CN: 把 Column 渲染的 100 条静态列表改成 LazyColumn，并为每项提供稳定 key。
prompt.en: Turn a 100-row statically rendered Column into a LazyColumn and give each row a stable key.

hint.zh-CN: items(items, key = { it.id }) { item -> Row(item) }；key 用业务唯一 ID 而非下标。
hint.en: Use items(items, key = { it.id }) { item -> Row(item) } with a business unique id rather than the index.

summary.zh-CN: 组合函数应当无副作用；需要加载数据或注册监听时用 LaunchedEffect/DisposableEffect，并让 key 决定重启时机。
summary.en: Composables should be side-effect free; load data or register listeners with LaunchedEffect/DisposableEffect, and use keys to control when they restart.

zh-CN: 用 LaunchedEffect(key) 在进入界面时加载数据
说明副作用写在组合函数体内直接执行的风险
en: Load data on entering a screen with LaunchedEffect(key)
Explain the risk of running side effects directly in a composable body

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个进入界面时加载用户数据的 LaunchedEffect，并让 userId 变化时自动重新加载。
prompt.en: Write a LaunchedEffect that loads user data when a screen opens and reloads automatically when userId changes.

hint.zh-CN: LaunchedEffect(userId) { data = loadUser(userId) }；如果不需要重启就传 Unit。
hint.en: Use LaunchedEffect(userId) { data = loadUser(userId) }; pass Unit when no restart is needed.

summary.zh-CN: Activity 经历创建、启动、恢复、暂停、停止、销毁等回调；资源申请与释放要放在成对的生命周期点。
summary.en: An Activity goes through create, start, resume, pause, stop and destroy callbacks; acquire and release resources at paired lifecycle points.

zh-CN: 说出 onCreate/onStart/onResume/onPause/onStop/onDestroy 的常见职责
把注册与注销放到成对的回调中
en: Describe the usual responsibility of onCreate/onStart/onResume/onPause/onStop/onDestroy
Pair registration and unregistration in matching callbacks

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个界面写监听器注册/注销代码，并说明为什么不能只在 onCreate 注册。
prompt.en: Write listener registration and unregistration for a screen and explain why registering only in onCreate is wrong.

hint.zh-CN: 在 onStart 注册、onStop 注销可以避免不可见时仍收到回调。
hint.en: Register in onStart and unregister in onStop so callbacks stop while the screen is not visible.

summary.zh-CN: 旋转屏幕、切换深色模式会重建界面；用 rememberSaveable 保存临时界面状态，用 ViewModel 保存业务状态。
summary.en: Rotation and dark-mode switches recreate the UI; keep transient UI state with rememberSaveable and business state in a ViewModel.

zh-CN: 区分 rememberSaveable 与 ViewModel 的保存范围
在配置变更后恢复输入中的内容
en: Distinguish what rememberSaveable and ViewModel survive
Restore in-progress input after a configuration change

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个输入框，旋转设备后内容仍然保留，并说明为什么不用 remember。
prompt.en: Build a text field whose content survives rotation and explain why remember alone is not enough.

hint.zh-CN: 临时界面状态用 rememberSaveable；跨页面业务状态放 ViewModel。
hint.en: Use rememberSaveable for transient UI state and a ViewModel for shared business state.

summary.zh-CN: 显式 Intent 指定目标组件；隐式 Intent 声明动作与数据，由系统匹配可处理的应用。
summary.en: An explicit intent names the target component; an implicit intent declares an action and data and lets the system match a handler.

zh-CN: 用显式 Intent 打开应用内页面
用隐式 Intent 打开系统能力（如网页、拨号）
en: Open an in-app screen with an explicit intent
Open a system capability such as a web page or dialer with an implicit intent

prompt.zh-CN: 分别写一个显式 Intent 打开详情页，以及一个隐式 ACTION_VIEW 打开网址，并说明后者为什么要判断可处理应用。
prompt.en: Write an explicit intent to open a detail screen and an implicit ACTION_VIEW to open a URL, then explain why the latter must check for a handler.

hint.zh-CN: 隐式 Intent 用 resolveActivity 或 try/catch ActivityNotFoundException 兜底。
hint.en: Guard an implicit intent with resolveActivity or catch ActivityNotFoundException.

summary.zh-CN: 用 rememberLauncherForActivityResult 注册结果回调，替代已弃用的 startActivityForResult，并区分取消与失败。
summary.en: Register a result callback with rememberLauncherForActivityResult instead of the deprecated startActivityForResult, and distinguish cancellation from failure.

zh-CN: 注册 ActivityResultLauncher 并处理返回结果
在结果为空时区分用户取消与错误
en: Register an ActivityResultLauncher and handle the result
Distinguish user cancellation from an error when the result is empty

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个选择图片并用结果更新界面的 launcher，同时处理用户取消的情况。
prompt.en: Write a launcher that picks an image and updates the UI with the result, handling the cancelled case too.

hint.zh-CN: uri 为 null 通常表示取消；区分 RESULT_OK 与 RESULT_CANCELED。
hint.en: A null uri usually means cancellation; distinguish RESULT_OK from RESULT_CANCELED.

summary.zh-CN: 字符串、颜色、尺寸放到 res/values 与 res/values-zh-rCN 等限定符目录，通过 R 或 stringResource 访问。
summary.en: Strings, colors and dimensions live in res/values and qualified directories such as res/values-zh-rCN and are read through R or stringResource.

zh-CN: 把硬编码文案移到 strings.xml 并支持中英双语
解释限定符目录如何按语言和设备选择资源
en: Move hardcoded copy into strings.xml with Chinese and English
Explain how qualifier directories select resources by language and device

prompt.zh-CN: 把界面里的三处硬编码中文移到 strings.xml，并补充英文翻译。
prompt.en: Move three hardcoded Chinese strings from the UI into strings.xml and add English translations.

hint.zh-CN: res/values/strings.xml 与 res/values-en/strings.xml 同名 key 不同文案；Compose 用 stringResource(R.string.xxx)。
hint.en: Use the same key in res/values/strings.xml and res/values-en/strings.xml; in Compose call stringResource(R.string.xxx).

summary.zh-CN: 用 MaterialTheme 的 colorScheme/typography 统一视觉；深色模式通过 colorScheme 与 isSystemInDarkTheme 适配。
summary.en: Unify visuals through MaterialTheme colorScheme and typography; adapt dark mode through colorScheme and isSystemInDarkTheme.

zh-CN: 用 MaterialTheme 包裹界面并读取主题色
实现随系统切换的深色与浅色配色
en: Wrap a screen in MaterialTheme and read theme colors
Provide light and dark color schemes that follow the system

prompt.zh-CN: 定义浅色与深色两套 colorScheme，并让界面文字颜色随系统模式变化。
prompt.en: Define light and dark color schemes and let text colors follow the system mode.

hint.zh-CN: isSystemInDarkTheme() 选择配色；组件里用 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface 而不是写死颜色。
hint.en: Choose the scheme with isSystemInDarkTheme() and use MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface instead of hardcoded colors.

title.zh-CN: 权限概览与运行时申请

summary.zh-CN: 危险权限（相机、定位、通知等）需要在清单声明并在运行时请求；拒绝后要给出可用降级路径。
summary.en: Dangerous permissions such as camera, location and notifications must be declared in the manifest and requested at runtime; after a denial provide a usable fallback.

zh-CN: 区分普通权限与危险权限
用 ActivityResult API 申请权限并处理拒绝
en: Distinguish normal from dangerous permissions
Request a permission with the ActivityResult API and handle denial

prompt.zh-CN: 为拍照功能写权限申请流程，并在用户拒绝后展示「用示例图片继续」的降级入口。
prompt.en: Write a permission flow for taking a photo and, after denial, show a fallback that continues with a sample image.

hint.zh-CN: 先用 checkSelfPermission 判断，再 launch；拒绝不等于抛异常，功能要继续可用。
hint.en: Call checkSelfPermission before launching; denial is not an exception and the feature should stay usable.
